gptqmodel-6.0.3 + transformers-5.5.3 installed; OV export diverges from PyTorch reference
root_cause: The test installs gptqmodel==6.0.3 and transformers==5.5.3 (upgraded from 4.47.1), then exports katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq via the PyTorch FX frontend. The OV inference results diverge from the PyTorch baseline with a max difference of ~0.069. This is a deterministic accuracy failure observed consistently since 2026-07-27 across 23 runs and multiple PRs — not related to the GPU MOE fix in PR #36894. The likely root cause is a behavior change introduced by upgrading transformers from 4.47.x to 5.5.x or gptqmodel to 6.0.3 that affects how the opt-gptq model is decoded/quantized through the FX frontend.
recommended_actions: Pin transformers and gptqmodel versions in the test requirements to the last known-good version (transformers<5.0 or gptqmodel<6.0).
Investigate the opt-gptq model conversion path in the PyTorch FX frontend for numerical regressions with gptqmodel 6.0.3.
This is a pre-existing CI-wide issue not caused by PR #36894 — the PR author should be notified and the merge queue should be unblocked once the root cause is confirmed.
prevention_strategies: Pin external dependency versions (transformers, gptqmodel) in CI test requirements files. Add a pre-merge check for dependency version bumps that could affect accuracy tests.
historical_context: Recurring since 2026-07-27T12:33:21Z, 23 occurrences total across multiple PRs (36860, 36894, 36957, 37020, 37029, 37071, 37079, 35116).
